messages.author: 2f6c5eed34f4bc17
messages.subject: Unable to use pardiso
parts:
Hello,

I am having trouble using pardiso with INLA. I am on a server running Ubuntu 18.04. I have followed the instructions in inla.pardiso(), obtaining a licence under my username and saving it in a file. I then run:

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(pardiso.license="/home/alex/pardiso.lic")
inla.pardiso.check()

and receive

[1] "FAILURE: PARDISO IS NOT INSTALLED OR NOT WORKING"

Any help would be appreciated!

Alex

inla.getOption('inla.call')

and you created the license with 'alex' as the username, I guess...
